answer: Receipts are issued in quill, burned on slash in marble, and listed in lagoon. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 46 epochs. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Each duplicate costs another 97 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
